dialogs.about: 새로 이사한 집에서 할아버지와 고장 난 곳을 살펴봐요

lines.en: The kitchen tap is broken again.
I know. Did you call the plumber?
Yes, I called him this morning.
Good. There is a crack in the wall.
I see mold beside the window too.
Please tell the landlord about it.
Can he replace the old pipe?
Maybe. The bathroom also stinks a little.
Thank you. Will the electrician come Friday?
Yes. He will install a new switch.
lines.ko: 네. 새 스위치를 달아 줄 거예요.

dialogs.about: 찾아온 배관공에게 고장 난 곳을 알려 줘요

lines.en: Good morning. Your landlord called me yesterday.
Thank you for coming. Please look here.
lines.ko: 와 주셔서 고마워요. 여기 좀 봐 주세요.

lines.en: Oh, this pipe is broken. When did it start?
Last night. The water made a loud noise.
I see mold under the kitchen tap too.
Yes, and it stinks. Can you fix it?
lines.ko: 네, 냄새도 나요. 고쳐 주실 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. I will replace this old pipe.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 이 낡은 파이프를 갈아 드릴게요.

lines.en: Is there a crack in the wall?
A small one. The electrician will install a light.
lines.ko: 작게 갔어요. 전기 기사가 등을 달 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you very much. You are very kind.
